# Entropy reference traces

These scripts and complete expected traces are generated by
`tools/reference/generate_entropy_fixtures.py` using the separately compiled C
oracle from Git revision `503d81b138d76621aae4b12786e90de48aa8db3a`.

```sh
./tools/reference/build.sh
python3 tools/reference/generate_entropy_fixtures.py
cargo test --test reference_entropy
```

The tests compare every encoded and decoded symbol's whole-bit count,
fractional-bit count, arithmetic range, and error flag, together with the
complete output packet and decoded values. The facade under test calls the same
entropy implementation used by the audio codec.

Coverage includes 768 deterministic mixed operations, 8-bit and 16-bit inverse
CDFs, raw-bit widths 1 through 25, uniform integers through `u32::MAX`, initial
bit patching at three carry-propagation stages, shrinking, empty storage,
overlapping streams, output overflow, and malformed uniform-integer decoding.
The `corrupted_uint` fixture deliberately overflows a one-byte encoder buffer
and verifies the decoder's sticky error and clamped return value.

These fixtures establish regression coverage for entropy coding; they do not
establish complete audio-codec compatibility.
